notifications_method.label: Notification Method
notifications_method.help: Notification method. auto: automatically detect terminal (iTerm.app, Ghostty, WezTerm use osc9, others fallback to bel); osc9: send OSC 9 escape sequence; bel: send BEL character; off: completely disable completion notifications

notifications_threshold_secs.label: Trigger Threshold (secs)
notifications_threshold_secs.help: Only remind if the task lasts longer than this

notifications_completion_sound.label: Completion Sound
notifications_completion_sound.help: Completion sound. beep: system default beep (default); off: disable completion sound; bell: use terminal bell; file: play custom WAV file (specify path via sound_file)

notifications_include_summary.label: Include Summary
notifications_include_summary.help: Whether the notification message includes the task result summary

notifications_quiet.label: Mute All Notifications
notifications_quiet.help: Suppress all desktop notifications and event sounds

notifications_event_turn_complete.label: Turn Complete Notification
notifications_event_turn_complete.help: Send notification when agent turn completes

notifications_event_subagent_terminal.label: Subagent Terminal Notification
notifications_event_subagent_terminal.help: Send notification when subagent reaches terminal state

notifications_event_approval_needed.label: Approval Needed Notification
notifications_event_approval_needed.help: Send notification when tool call waits for approval

notifications_event_input_needed.label: Input Needed Notification
notifications_event_input_needed.help: Send notification when agent asks for input

notifications_event_elevation_needed.label: Elevation Needed Notification
notifications_event_elevation_needed.help: Send notification when sandbox rejection requires decision

notifications_event_model_notify.label: Model Notification
notifications_event_model_notify.help: Send notification when model calls notify tool

notifications_event_sound_enabled.label: Enable Event Sounds
notifications_event_sound_enabled.help: Play alert sounds for notification events
